promptId.description: The promptId of one of this session's own messages, as recall_user_prompts returned it. The transcript of a message said in another session is refused.

limit.description: The most entries to answer, in the order they were written. The default is 20.

after.description: The key of the last entry of an earlier answer for the same promptId: the read goes on with the entry that follows it. Without it the read starts at the message. A key that is not an entry of this message's turn is refused.
